changes.from: How should the Windows version share the engine? The core is Swift (Foundation only, apart from the spell checker). Options: (a) keep Swift and build it with the Swift toolchain for Windows, called from a small C++ TSF text service; (b) rewrite the core in a portable language (Rust or C++) and use it everywhere. Recommended: (a). Also: which release channel (signed installer needs a code-signing certificate, a cost; Microsoft Store has a fee)? I can't run or test Windows on this Mac, so a Windows machine or VM is needed to check it.
